definitions.meaning: a small swivelling wheel fixed under a chair or trolley
an oil pressed from the beans of a plant, long used as a laxative

explanation.definitionFit: A swivelling furniture wheel and the laxative oil from a bean share this one name.

clue.text: One covering end of chin in spots

indicators.note: the word for one wraps around the letter taken, covering it on both sides

parts.note: the ace is the card counting as one

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter, here of chin

explanation.surface: A single blemish appears on the tip of someone's chin among their spots.
explanation.definitionFit: Spots on the face are the outward sign of this skin condition, so the plural noun names it.

clue.text: Leaving a permanent impression on somebody

definitions.text: Leaving a permanent impression on somebody

parts.words: Leaving a permanent impression on somebody
parts.note: reads as making an unforgettable impact on a person, but literally means marking their skin with ink for good

explanation.surface: Someone makes a lasting mark on another person's memory.
explanation.definitionFit: Inking a design into the skin leaves a literal permanent mark on somebody's body.

definitions.meaning: wound in a fishing line on its reel

explanation.surface: Someone tottered about yet still managed to join the queue.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to sway unsteadily and to wind a fishing line in on a reel.

clue.text: First-class student to provide the final touch

parts.note: capital is an old-fashioned word for excellent
L stands for learner, as on a learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A top-grade student is asked to add the finishing flourish to some work.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to crown or complete something, giving it a final touch, often an unwelcome one.

parts.note: suggests a versatile cricketer or sportsman, but means someone who has sailed right round the world

explanation.surface: A tribute to one of sport's great versatile players.
explanation.walkthrough: An all-rounder in cricket is a player who both bats and bowls well; here the word means one who goes all round the globe.
explanation.definitionFit: A sailor who travels all the way round the globe is literally a great all-rounder.

clue.text: Animal in roles that offer limited protection

indicators.note: the animal word sits inside the word for roles

parts.note: parts are the roles actors play
an ape is an animal

explanation.surface: An animal is cast in parts that keep it only partly safe.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a relative clause standing for 'things that offer limited protection', the low walls along a roof or bridge.
explanation.definitionFit: Low protective walls along a bridge or roof edge guard only partly against a fall.

parts.note: Don Quixote famously tilted at windmills, charging with his lance
H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: A distressing, idealistic attack is launched by a man named Henry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Harrowing' looks like an adjective meaning distressing; it is the farming noun, breaking up soil with a harrow.
explanation.definitionFit: Cultivation of land, such as harrowing the soil, is one sense of this farming word.

parts.note: sounds like a couple whose marriage gives stability, but describes two parts that together fasten a door

explanation.surface: A couple whose marriage gives them a sense of safety.
explanation.definitionFit: A fastening and the device that turns it work together to keep things securely shut.

clue.text: A winter kit without it? Strange

definitions.text: A winter kit without it? Strange

indicators.note: the letters of the word it are left out of the pool before rearranging
strange signals the remaining letters are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether a set of cold-weather clothes would be odd without one item.
explanation.walkthrough: Take IT out of A WINTER KIT and rearrange AWNERKIT; the whole clue also describes woollen winter clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Woollen jumpers and scarves made by knitting are the obvious winter kit.

indicators.note: the churchgoers surround the priest as if protecting him

parts.note: RCs are Roman Catholics
Eli is the priest in the Book of Samuel

explanation.surface: Worshippers protect the mortal remains of their priest.
explanation.definitionFit: Relics are surviving remains, especially the bones of a saint kept for veneration.

parts.note: a bounder is a cad, but also something that leaps, which stays a leap in front

explanation.surface: Asks what a sly cad managed to maintain.
explanation.definitionFit: Staying a step ahead of rivals is the idiom; for a leaper it is a literal leap in front.

indicators.note: chaos signals the letters are thrown into disorder and rearranged

explanation.surface: Creating pure mayhem nonetheless makes things better.
explanation.definitionFit: To recover health or strength after illness is to get better, i.e. improve.

indicators.note: endless means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: peril is danger

explanation.surface: A never-ending threat hangs over a fairy.
explanation.definitionFit: In Persian myth a peri is a fairy or beautiful spirit.

clue.text: They're used by writers and poets for revision

indicators.note: revising a text reworks it, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Writers and poets use them when revising their work.
explanation.definitionFit: Pads of paper for jotting notes are standard writers' equipment.

parts.note: a pan is a shallow bowl-shaped vessel
to handle something is to manage it

explanation.surface: A person begging copes with nothing but a bowl.
explanation.definitionFit: In American slang the verb means to beg from passers-by in the street.

indicators.note: turn signals the letters are turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone caught out spins round and sneers.
explanation.definitionFit: Caught in a snare or net, so trapped.

clue.text: New venture to captivate grand Russian writer

indicators.note: the rearranged letters hold the letter inside them, as if captivating it
new signals the letters of venture are made into a new arrangement

parts.note: G is slang for a grand, a thousand pounds

explanation.surface: A fresh enterprise aims to charm a great Russian author.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' rearranges VENTURE as TURENEV, and 'to captivate' puts G inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivan Turgenev, author of Fathers and Sons, is a celebrated Russian novelist.

clue.text: Japanese play the Spanish in season

parts.note: No (or Noh) is classical Japanese drama
el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: A Japanese drama and something Spanish are staged at a certain time of year.
explanation.definitionFit: Noel is another name for Christmas, the festive season.

clue.text: Reason for raising money in state

indicators.note: the turned word goes inside the word for state

parts.note: to state is to say

indicators.note: in a down entry raising reads the word upwards, backwards

parts.note: tin is slang for money

explanation.surface: Someone gives a justification for collecting funds within a country.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer 'raising' means read upwards, so the money word appears as NIT; 'Reason' is the noun for a sound mind, not a cause.
explanation.definitionFit: Reason in the sense of a sound mind is sanity.

clue.text: One in favour of the classics

definitions.text: One in favour of the classics

parts.words: One in favour of the classics
parts.note: sounds like a fan of Greek and Latin, but means someone favoured, in a Latin phrase

explanation.surface: Describes a person who supports traditional classical learning.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase is Latin, the language of the classics, for a person who is acceptable or welcome.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin diplomatic term means a welcome person, someone in favour.

definitions.meaning: to begin work on something vigorously

explanation.surface: Someone begins to brawl.
explanation.definitionFit: As a phrasal verb it means begin vigorously; hyphenated it is a noun for a scrap.

clue.text: Settled one in a small apartment

indicators.note: the numeral goes inside the word for the flat

parts.note: a pad is slang for a flat
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A lone resident has settled into a little flat.
explanation.definitionFit: A settled bill is one that has been paid off.

definitions.meaning: a topic or issue under discussion
to be important, as in it does not concern me

explanation.surface: A topic worth worrying about.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun means a topic; the verb means to be important or of concern.

definitions.meaning: Kim Philby, the spy dubbed the so-called third member of the Cambridge ring
a fielding position in cricket, behind the slips

explanation.surface: The spy Kim Philby is spotted out in the countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: Kim Philby was long suspected as the 'third' man who tipped off Burgess and Maclean; in cricket it is a fielding position on the off side behind the slips.
explanation.definitionFit: The nickname for Philby in the Cambridge spy affair is also a cricket fielding position.

definitions.meaning: a woodwind instrument played by blowing
a part-time judge in English courts

explanation.surface: A tool used by the legal system.
explanation.walkthrough: In England a recorder is a barrister or solicitor sitting as a part-time judge.
explanation.definitionFit: A woodwind pipe and a part-time judge both go by this name.

clue.text: Gives up the struggle with crops

explanation.surface: A farmer surrenders the fight with the harvest.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means surrenders, and the plural noun means the produce of a harvest.
